title: Post office job and meeting John Levy
summary: His father pushed him into a special delivery job at the post office at about sixteen, where he met pianist John Levy.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: So I stayed there and struggled and thought, and it's -- you mentioned John Levy. I've got to tell you about John Levy. I -- my father was a postman, and he insisted that I go into the post office as a special delivery boy. I think I was around 16 years old then. But I wanted to play music, I didn't want to be in -- and I finally went down, just to appease my father, and that's where I met John Levy. This was in Chicago. John Levy was playing piano like Earl Hines, and he was a piano player. I think I was playing banjo.
